overloads.semanticRole: Record number returns the physical record number for the current record of aTable .

constraints: Returns -1 (No current record constant) if there is no current record (e.g. the record pointer is before/after the current selection).
Returns -3 (New record constant) if the current record is a new record that has not yet been saved.
Record numbers can change over time; deleted records' numbers are reused.
4D Server: for the On Validate form event, returns a real record number in local mode but -3 in remote mode, because the record is already created server-side but not yet sent to the client.
Prefer Is new record to test whether a record is currently being created.
